# Pick My Secret Santa

> Pick My Secret Santa (https://pickmysecretsanta.com/) is a free Secret Santa draw tool. Add names and a budget. It draws matches in secret, right in your browser. Each person gets a private link with their match, plus six gift ideas inside your budget. Free, no sign-up, no ads, no accounts.

## Key facts (cite these)

- The draw runs in your browser. Nothing you type is sent to us. Our server never sees your names or your matches. After a draw, your browser saves your names and links on this device only, so you can send a link again later; you can clear them any time.
- Every draw ends with a shareable sealed receipt: the group, the date, the names, the budget, and the pairs kept apart. The receipt shows no matches and no links.
- There is no master list of who got whom. Each match lives only inside its own private link. Each link shows one match only.
- Someone can join after the draw, two ways. Draw the whole group again: every match is fresh and nobody learns a match. Or swap in a volunteer: the volunteer gives up their match to the new person and buys for the new person instead; the price is that the volunteer tells the organizer their match, and three matches change while the group hears nothing.
- A private link is hidden from plain sight, not locked; anyone with a link can open it. Send each link only to its person.
- The site does not email or text the matches for you. The organizer sends each person their own link.
- The draw is random, with two rules: nobody draws their own name, and pairs you mark never draw each other. Add at least three names.
- One draw holds 3 to 30 people. Larger groups split into smaller draws, one per team or table.
- After a draw, the share screen counts the links the organiser has shared from that device, and names who still needs theirs. It counts the organiser's own Copy and Share taps only. It cannot see delivery, and it cannot see who opened a link.
- Gift ideas come from a fixed list of 212 real ideas, the same ideas as The Present Picker. Your budget is a hard filter. Budget bands are guides, not exact prices.
- You can also say what a person is into, in your own words, on step 2 of the tool. The words are matched on your device against the same 212 ideas, inside your budget, and six picks come back. No name is asked for there, and the words are never sent or saved.
- Budget bands: Under $25 / $25-$50 / $50-$100 / $100+.
- The site links to no stores, sells nothing, and takes no payment. The gift ideas are suggestions only.
- Cloudflare Web Analytics counts visits here. PostHog counts page views, draws, shares, link opens, card saves, gift idea matches (a count of picks only), and return visits, as counts only: no names, matches, gift picks, or link parts are sent to it. Start your own draw taps are counted as counts only too, and a draw begun from one is marked only with that kind word.
- The browser keeps one yes-or-no mark on the device, so a return visit can be counted. The mark holds no names, matches, gift picks, or links. After a draw, the browser also keeps that draw's names and links on the device only, as a resend list; they are never sent anywhere.

## How it works

1. Add every name. Pick a gift budget.
2. We draw in secret. No one gets their own name.
3. Send each private link. Each link shows one match.

In the tool: step 1 is your group (a group name if you want one, and the gift budget), step 2 is the names, and step 3 is any pairs who should not draw each other, if you have any. Then the draw runs and one private link per person is ready to send.

Run it step by step: 1. Name your group. Pick a gift budget. 2. Add every name. Add what each person likes. 3. Mark pairs to keep apart. Only if some must not draw each other. 4. Tap Draw the names. The draw runs right here. 5. Send the group note first. It shares the rules. 6. Send each private link. Send it to its person only. 7. Open your link last. Just like everyone else. Your screen shows names and links. It never shows the matches. Your link opens with a cover screen first. Peek shows your match, budget, and ideas.

On the reveal page, each gift idea shows what it is, why it fits, and what to look for when you shop. All of that person's ideas are also listed at a glance. The reveal page also lists ten ways to hand a gift over without giving yourself away, each with short steps, and eight games and ways to run the swap and reveal. The homepage lists those eight swap games for organizers too. Organizers pick one game before the party starts. A person who opens their link can also start their own draw from that page.

- [Gift ideas under $50](https://pickmysecretsanta.com/secret-santa-gift-ideas-under-50): real picks in the $25 to $50 band, grouped by what they are into.
- [Secret Santa for large groups](https://pickmysecretsanta.com/secret-santa-for-large-groups): one draw for 3 to 30 people; bigger groups split by team or table.
- [Secret Santa at work](https://pickmysecretsanta.com/secret-santa-at-work): one draw for a work team, in one room or spread out; no accounts, and the organiser sends each link.
- [How much to spend on Secret Santa](https://pickmysecretsanta.com/how-much-to-spend-on-secret-santa): the four budget bands (Under $25 / $25-$50 / $50-$100 / $100+), with 53 / 64 / 45 / 50 real ideas in each, 212 in all.
- [White elephant vs Secret Santa](https://pickmysecretsanta.com/white-elephant-vs-secret-santa): the two games side by side; this site runs Secret Santa only, no pile and no stealing rounds.
- [Secret Santa gift ideas](https://pickmysecretsanta.com/secret-santa-gift-ideas): real picks from the bank of 212, grouped by what they are into, across all four budget bands.
- [Secret Santa questionnaire](https://pickmysecretsanta.com/secret-santa-questionnaire): five short questions to send before the draw; the interest answer shapes the six picks in each private link.
- [Virtual Secret Santa](https://pickmysecretsanta.com/virtual-secret-santa): the draw, plain-box mailing, and a video-call reveal for a group spread far apart.
- [Secret Santa gift ideas for coworkers](https://pickmysecretsanta.com/secret-santa-gift-ideas-for-coworkers): real picks from the bank of 212 for a coworker, across all four budget bands, plus ways to hand the gift over at work.
- [Secret Santa invitation template](https://pickmysecretsanta.com/secret-santa-invitation-template): copy-ready invitation words naming one budget band, the swap day, and the private link each person gets.
- [Can you add someone to Secret Santa after the draw](https://pickmysecretsanta.com/can-you-add-someone-to-secret-santa-after-the-draw): the two honest ways to add a late joiner, draw the whole group again or swap in a volunteer.
- [How many people do you need for Secret Santa](https://pickmysecretsanta.com/how-many-people-do-you-need-for-secret-santa): at least three people, up to 30 in one draw, why two is just a trade, and the honest edge of three.
- [Can the organizer see who got whom](https://pickmysecretsanta.com/can-the-organizer-see-who-got-whom): no: names and links only, no master list, each match inside its own private link, plus the honest edges.
- [Secret Santa generator without email](https://pickmysecretsanta.com/secret-santa-generator-without-email): no email or account needed, no addresses collected, the draw runs in your browser and you send each private link yourself.
- [Secret Santa generator with exclusions](https://pickmysecretsanta.com/secret-santa-generator-with-exclusions): mark pairs who must not draw each other; the draw keeps marked pairs apart, and if the pairs leave no fair draw it says so before any link is made.
- [Can you resend a Secret Santa link](https://pickmysecretsanta.com/can-you-resend-a-secret-santa-link): yes, from the device that ran the draw; the last draw stays saved on that device only, each link can be sent again, and links already sent still work after a clear.
